title: Shared roof inspection
body: Shall we request quotations for a joint roof inspection? Each member with voting rights may cast one final vote.

title: Chimney sweeping: organise together
body: A shared case will open 45 days before the inspection. Please use the case conversation to coordinate access.

title: Joint meter replacement
body:
Park Court is organising a joint replacement of the water meters so residents can coordinate access and compare quotations together.

Please check which meters are in your apartment and note any access restrictions. Add questions and suggested service providers to the joint meter replacement case; the case admin will collect the proposals.

The final contractor, price and appointment will be confirmed after the quotations have been reviewed. No work has been booked yet. Residents will receive the agreed arrangements before access is required.

title: Garden maintenance proposal
body: Prepare the proposal before publishing it to residents.

title: Joint meter replacement: request quotations
body:
Should Park Court request quotations for replacing the apartment water meters together?

A Yes vote supports collecting and comparing quotations. It does not approve a contractor, price or work date. Those details will be shared with residents after the proposals arrive.

Members with voting rights may vote Yes, No or Abstain. Each member has one final vote.
